Print the bar plot of a logical variable into the RG

Source: R/03-02-booleplot.R
paste_booleplot.Rd

Reads the `rg_graphics` column of the DGF and draws the logical value counts with [booleplot()]: a fixed-geometry horizontal bar plot with the category names in the left margin and each bar's count and share (`22.6K (90.4 its right. Categories are sorted largest-to-smallest with the missing (`NA`) category last, drawn as a light bar with a steel-blue outline.

Usage

paste_booleplot(VNAME, LABEL = "VALUES")

Arguments

VNAME

A character string naming the DGF column to read (the layout passes `"rg_graphics"`).

LABEL

A character string for the section title. Defaults to `"VALUES"`.

Value

No return value; draws the bar plot into the RG.

Details

Internal to `create_div` in R/03-01-create-sections.R.
